tiers.name: Pre-Divide `grad / 256` + `255-Hop` Linear Ring `BF16` Hop-by-Hop Rounding
tiers.note: In a 256-rank linear Ring, once the running partial sum grows >128x larger than a rank's local BF16 gradient (7-bit mantissa), subsequent ranks' gradients are 100% swamped to zero!

tiers.name: Post-Divide `sum(grad) / 256` Linear Ring `BF16` (Still `O(N)` Sequential Rounding)
tiers.note: Avoids pre-division underflow, but 255 sequential BF16 additions still swamp contributions after hop 64–128!

tiers.name: Upcast Gradients to `FP32` Before Network Transmission (`2x` RDMA Bandwidth Tax)
tiers.note: Eliminates swamping completely, but doubles inter-node RDMA traffic and slows All-Reduce from 48ms to 91.5ms!

tiers.name: Hierarchical Pairwise Tree (`O(log N)` Depth) + Intra-SM/NVLS `FP32` Accumulator (`BF16` Wire) + Post-Scale
tiers.note: Transmits compact BF16 on the wire, accumulates in FP32 registers at each hop, uses log2(256)=8 tree depth (same-magnitude pairwise sums!), and divides by 256 at the end -> 99.95% signal retained at 44.2ms!
